map.某公司负债总额 1500 万元、资产总额 5000 万元，资产负债率=1500/: A company has total liabilities of 1500 (10k CNY) and total assets of 5000 (10k CNY), so the debt-to-asset ratio = 1500/5000 = 30%, meaning 30% of assets are funded by creditors - relatively low financial leverage.
map.资产负债率多高算危险？: How high is a dangerous debt-to-asset ratio?
map.无统一阈值，重资产行业（如公用事业）可容忍较高，轻资产或周期性行业宜偏低；一般认: There is no universal threshold; asset-heavy industries such as utilities can tolerate a higher ratio, while asset-light or cyclical industries should stay lower; a ratio above 70% generally means markedly reduced financial flexibility.
map.资产负债率与产权比率有何关系？: How does the debt-to-asset ratio relate to the debt-to-equity ratio?
map.产权比率=负债/所有者权益，资产负债率=负债/(负债+权益)，两者都衡量杠杆，可: Debt-to-equity = liabilities / owners' equity, while debt-to-asset = liabilities / (liabilities + equity); both measure leverage and can be converted into each other.
